meta.prompt_source: 用户提供的图表题面（英语二 Part B）

band.rationale: 对照第二档描述：本篇'基本完成了试题规定的任务'——描述图表与给出评论两个要点均覆盖，三组数据（35%/45%/20%）全部呈现；'有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解'——percentage 三次误用、does not provides、volunteer activities is、逗号粘连等错误密集，但全文仍可读懂；'采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰'——Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 串联描述—原因—评论三段。语言准确度达不到第四档'语言基本准确，只有在试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误'的要求，错误多为基础性而非尝试复杂结构所致，故定第三档。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据与类别均已覆盖、未偏题，但总述句 the situation of students taking part in 未点明图表核心是'每月参加次数的占比'，且缺少对比性概括（如多数学生每月仅参加 1-2 次）；描述句本身语言错误也削弱了图表信息的传达。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. ... It can help us learn skill and make friend.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 给出两条原因和评论，方向正确但每条仅一句话、无展开（无例证、无数据回扣），评论段停留在口号式建议；135 词为建议下限的 90%（soft_ok），按规则不机械罚分，仅提示略短使展开受限。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ... In my opinion, ...
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式（描述—原因—评论）清晰，Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion/while 等衔接可用，层次基本清楚；但存在逗号粘连句影响局部连贯，段内推进方式单一。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join
dimensions.deduction_reason: does not provides、volunteer activities is、learn skill and make friend、逗号粘连、the the 笔误等基础错误反复出现，但整体仍可理解；句式以简单句为主，仅 Only in this way can we... 一处倒装且使用正确。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities
dimensions.deduction_reason: percentage/percent 三次误用，join、join in 与 take part in 混用且后接宾语缺失，learn skill、make friend 可数名词裸用，grow up better 中式直译，搭配问题密集；词汇面窄、重复度高（volunteer activities 全文反复）。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 无格式扣分：三段式议论文布局完整，分段合理（预检 3 段）。

consistency.adjustments: 初评维度分合计 3+1.5+1.5+1+0.5+1=8.5，落在第三档 7-9 区间内，一次校验通过，未调整。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of students taking part in 表述含混，未点明图表核心是'每月参加次数的占比'；in a university 泛指不自然
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 不可直接接数字，应为 percent 或写作 35%；take part in one to two times 缺宾语，'参加一到两次'应说 volunteer one to two times a month；join in volunteer activities 搭配不地道
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them volunteer one to two times a month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 20 percentage students 应为 20 percent of the students；join 后缺宾语，应说 join in volunteer activities three times or more 或直接用 volunteer
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students volunteer three times or more a month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写有误，应为 phenomenon
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: think study is 中 study 前宜加限定词（their studies）更自然；spend all their time 语气过于绝对
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students believe that their studies are more important than volunteer work, so they spend almost all their spare time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: does not provides 应为 does not provide；两个完整句仅用逗号连接构成逗号粘连，应用 so/and 连接；how to join 后缺宾语；正式文体中缩略形式 don't 宜写作 do not
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join them.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致：volunteer activities 为复数，is 应为 are
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词单数不可裸用：learn skill 应为 learn skills 或 learn new skills，make friend 应为 make friends；指代复数 activities 应用 They 而非 It
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn new skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the the 重复（预检脚本报出的相邻重复词）；balance the study 应为 balance their studies；并列句 and 前宜加逗号
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more opportunities, and students should balance their studies and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: grow up better 为'更好地成长'的中式直译，grow up 多指儿童长大成人，语义与语境不贴
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we truly grow and benefit from these experiences.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. According to the chart, 35 percent of the students never participate in such activities, while 45 percent volunteer only one to two times a month. Merely 20 percent join in volunteer work three times or more.

Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, many students believe that their studies matter more than anything else, so they spend almost all their spare time in the library. Secondly, the university does not provide enough information about volunteer programs, and as a result, many students simply do not know how to get involved.

In my opinion, volunteer activities benefit students in many ways: they help us pick up practical skills, make new friends and develop a sense of responsibility. Therefore, the university should offer more opportunities, and students should learn to balance their studies with volunteer work. Only in this way can we truly grow through these experiences.
top_problems: 核心词汇与搭配误用贯穿全文：percentage/percent 三次误用、join 与 take part in 混用且宾语缺失、learn skill / make friend 可数名词裸用，同时拉低词汇与语法两个维度。
基础语法错误密集：does not provides、逗号粘连、volunteer activities is 主谓不一致、the the 笔误，是分数被压在第三档、无法上探第四档的主要原因。
图表描述与论证都停留在一句话层面：首段未点明'每月频次占比'这一图表核心并缺少对比性概括，原因段两条理由均无展开，内容维度得分受限。
practice_advice: 每写一篇图表作文，固定用两个句型各造三句并自查：'数字+percent of the students + 动词'和 'volunteer / take part in + 活动 + once or twice a month'，造句时逐个核对名词单复数与动词原形（does not 后接原形），坚持两周可消除本篇 80% 以上的语言失误。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... every month.
X percent of the students ..., while Y percent ...
Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
In my opinion, ... Therefore, ... Only in this way can we ...
words: take part in / participate in volunteer activities
balance their studies with volunteer work
